scope: Static resource inventory of BuildConflictPromptQuestion and its shared FormatConflictProblemText/ConflictClassMessageId; no build or runtime tests
method: Distinct localization resource IDs, not enum values, rendered strings or grammatical sentences.
The card overrides four generic class summaries with overlap/live-output/permanent-delete variants; direct Issues/problem formatting can still use those four.
ReadOnlyRegularFile and ReadOnlyRegularFileExists share one base resource.
Includes Outcome unknown because this resource is emitted by the error formatter as problem text; excludes unrelated status rows, action/button labels, headings and fact-row resources.
Counts formatter branches statically; does not prove every enum/risk is currently produced by every provider route.

dynamicSources: TryFormatSystemMessage(GetSystemMessageIdFromHResult(status)) or supplied systemText for otherwise Unknown real HRESULTs.
Task IDs, paths, names, attempt numbers and consentDetail/consentNote supplied by producers are variable.
Question fragments can combine; final displayed sentences therefore do not have a fixed count.
capacityInterpretation: 64 bounds distinct task-local cached decision scopes, not question templates or selected files. Checked same-risk/same-root deferred consent reuses one receipt/cache scope; unchecked item-specific answers can independently consume up to64 receipt slots.
confidence: High for static resource-ID counts; no runtime validation performed
